decisions.title: EXAMPLE: Adopt this AI Guidance baseline as the project operating system
decisions.author: marcos@kineticmatrix.io
decisions.goal_link: Ensures every project is built to the same standard, surviving context compaction.
decisions.context: Why this decision is needed; the forces at play.
decisions.tradeoff: Adds upfront structure in exchange for long-term consistency and AI resumability.

horizons.mid_term: Faster onboarding of agents and humans.

decisions.title: Enforce state integrity and release gates with git hooks + CI, and automate KPI snapshots
decisions.author: marcos@kineticmatrix.io
decisions.goal_link: Makes the JSON-as-source-of-truth model machine-enforced rather than instruction-only, so state cannot silently drift.
decisions.context: The baseline relied on agents/humans remembering to update state and pass gates. Discipline alone is not deterministic; drift is inevitable at scale.

options_considered.option: Git hooks + CI enforcement + automated snapshots

decisions.decision: Add .githooks (pre-commit validate, pre-push gate on v* tags), CI workflows (state-validation, lighthouse-ci, kpi-snapshot), and scripts (validate_state, check_release_gate, snapshot_kpis).
decisions.tradeoff: Adds a python+git dependency and minor CI time in exchange for deterministic, self-enforcing state and zero-effort release bookkeeping.

horizons.short_term: Commits with invalid state are blocked; releases require passed gates.
horizons.mid_term: Release bookkeeping (KPI snapshot, memory, status reset) is automatic on tag.
horizons.long_term: State integrity scales across the whole portfolio without relying on memory.

decisions.title: Enforce a filled-in architecture description as a release gate
decisions.author: marcos@kineticmatrix.io
decisions.goal_link: Guarantees every project ships a written architecture so any agent/human can understand the system without reading all the code.
decisions.context: Projects drift into tribal knowledge when architecture lives only in code and people's heads. The baseline had an architecture docs folder but nothing required or verified a real description.

cons: self-reported; can be set true while the doc is empty

decisions.decision: Add a file-based check to check_release_gate.py requiring docs/architecture/overview.md to exist, contain no template placeholders, and have real substance (>= ~600 non-whitespace chars). Ship a canonical overview.md template; wire it into Pre-Flight, Build, and the release gate.
decisions.tradeoff: A content heuristic (length + placeholder scan) can't judge quality, only presence and effort, in exchange for a deterministic gate that can't be faked by flipping a flag.

horizons.short_term: Releases blocked until the architecture is actually written.
horizons.mid_term: Every project carries a current, readable architecture map; faster agent onboarding.
horizons.long_term: Portfolio-wide architectural legibility; less tribal knowledge as the system scales.
